tasks.text: Anyone can publish any information on the internet.
Always check the source and credibility of news!
The goal of fake news is often disinformation.
Wikipedia articles can be edited by anyone online.
The padlock icon in the browser indicates a secure connection.
Source criticism helps identify false information.
Do not believe everything you see on social media!
Scientific sites are generally more reliable sources.
The date of the news is important for checking freshness.
Ask a teacher if you find a suspicious website!
